title: AI-Assisted Evaluation of Unified Theories: Using Machine Learning to Test Alternative Explanations for Scientific Mysteries

contributions.purpose: 构建 AI 框架系统评估非主流统一理论以消除同行评审偏见
contributions.mechanism: 解释力量化(覆盖率/简约性/预测力)+一致性校验+区分性实验自动设计,以伪代码类实现
contributions.evaluation: 无真实运行结果;伪代码调用未定义方法(如 theory.provides_mechanism),指标为作者手工赋值
contributions.domain: 科学方法论/AI for science(非主流)
contributions.source_quote: We present an AI-assisted framework for systematically evaluating alternative unified theories that claim to explain these mysteries through single underlying principles.

contributions.purpose: 用该框架论证 Zhang 统一场论(UFT)优于标准模型
contributions.mechanism: 对 8 个物理'谜题'做覆盖率打分,与标准模型比简约性
contributions.evaluation: 自报 UFT 覆盖 87.5% vs 标准模型 65%,假设数 2 vs 19 参数('9 倍简约');数字均由作者自填字典产生,无独立验证
contributions.source_quote: Our analysis reveals that UFT offers superior explanatory coverage and parsimony compared to current physics models, while generating numerous testable predictions that could distinguish it from established theories.

contributions.purpose: 生成区分 UFT 与标准模型的实验设计
contributions.mechanism: 枚举两理论矛盾预测并按可行性排序,给出电荷加速引力测试($50k/3 月)与磁涡旋引力测试($75k/6 月)方案
contributions.evaluation: 自评 distinguishing power 0.95/0.90(主观赋值),实验均未执行
contributions.source_quote: Our AI system identified several testable UFT predictions: 1. Gravitational field generation by accelerating charges... Distinguishing power: High (Standard Model predicts no effect)

self_declared_provenance.quote: Using Zhang XiangQian's Unified Field Theory (UFT) as a test case, we demonstrate how machine learning can objectively assess explanatory power, generate testable predictions, and design optimal experiments to distinguish between competing paradigms.

Our framework addresses the systematic bias against unconventional theories by focusing on explanatory breadth, mathematical consistency, and empirical distinguishability rather than institutional credentials.

notes: Zhang UFT 系列第三篇(与 AS0018/AS0019 同源),实为为非主流理论辩护的立场文。协议适配问题:自称 machine learning 但全文只有不可运行的伪代码(调用未定义方法),所有'AI 评估'数字(coverage 0.875、distinguishing power 0.90-0.95)是作者手工写进字典的主观赋值,evaluation 格无客观实验。Table 1 自相矛盾:承认 UFT 'Experimental Support Low、Mathematical Consistency Medium(需形式化)'却结论 UFT superior,脚注辩称低支持'是资源限制而非理论缺陷'。checklist 问题:open access code 答 Yes 但代码为伪代码;statistical significance 答 Yes 引用的是主观 distinguishing power;compute resources 答 No。AI 参与度:假设[C]/实验[D]/分析[D]/写作[C]。无编号贡献列表,按 intro 框架 4 点归纳为 3 条。
